QuestInfo.name: Regardless of What I Want
QuestInfo.0: The foxes give you their best gift. While it's not a good gift for you, you should go thank them at least.
QuestInfo.1: The foxes gave you their best gift. While it's not a good gift for you, you should go thank them at least. Go to the village foxes and thank them.
QuestInfo.2: You thanked the foxes for giving you their best gift. But their reactions were quite cold. Silver said it's because you didn't give them anything in return.
